series.title: Borneo : Res. Z. en O. Afd. van Borneo
series.notes: Topographic map series of Borneo, Indonesia showing roads, railroads and populated places; some sheets also show vegetation, cultivated areas and water features. Relief shown by contours and spot heights. | Includes administrative index and index to adjoining sheets. | Later sheets published by the Topografische Dienst, first in Weltevreden then later in Batavia. | "Gegevens verzameld over de periode: 1920-1925."

creator: Netherlands. Topografische Dienst, cartographer. issuing body.
